summary: Surveyed all 64 listed Lean files under SphereEversion/ in the leanprover-community__sphere-eversion checkout (sizes 304 to 49074 bytes) and counted declaration keywords per file: 1240 in total, 63 of 64 files have at least one theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/abbrev/example declaration. No build config, scripts, or generated files are in the unit.
